summary: Create one browser-safe Tier-A settings manifest and derive Host ConfigSchema plus client field/default/draft metadata from it without changing settings behavior.
steps: Re-read current main after the Issue #69 merge and confirmed four open issues remain: #67, #73, #75 and #84.

Identified durableRoot as the only Tier-A field whose browser fallback is an empty string while ConfigSchema intentionally applies no absent-key default; encoded schemaDefault separately so the refactor cannot silently change Host behavior.

Added a pure manifest with no React/DOM/Cordis/Schemastery/Node imports, plus generated Tier-A/runtime setting types and focused tests that compare GUI metadata and Host defaults/ranges to the same source.

evidence.target: current main ConfigSchema and client RLM_FIELDS
evidence.note: All 14 keys/defaults/ranges/options were compared before the refactor; durableRoot no-default behavior is explicitly protected.
Production/client rewiring and final dual-OS gate are pending on this branch.

limitations: Tier-B provider/python/path validation remains intentionally in src/settings.ts.
This issue changes no UI copy/layout; Issue #75 follows after the manifest lands.
